lane.description: A row id of the requested instrument.

id.description: Section identifier referenced by arrangement, e.g. "A" or "fill".

lanes.description: The lanes that play in this section; omit silent lanes.

anyOf.description: One character per sixteenth step of one measure: '.' rest, 'g' ghost, 'x' normal, 'X' accent, '-' hold (extends the previous note by one step).
One velocity per sixteenth step of one measure, 0 for a rest, otherwise 1-127; every note has length 1.

LaneSteps.description: Either a step string or an array of per-step velocities.

description: A compact pattern: reusable one-measure sections plus an arrangement listing the section for each measure.

arrangement.description: Section id for each measure in order; repeated cyclically to fill the requested length.

name.description: Short human-readable title, e.g. "Dusty Boom Bap".

sections.description: One-measure building blocks, e.g. a main groove "A" and a "fill".

swing.description: Swing 0-0.75 (fraction of a sixteenth that off-beat sixteenths are delayed), or null.

tempo_bpm.description: Tempo in BPM (40-240) suited to the description, or null to use the requested tempo.
